name: StateFormValidation
title: Blocks/State/StateFormValidation
summary: A standalone form that walks through every state a submit can land in, one story per state, on a single Create Variable page with no card around it: a heading, then `Field`s wrapping `Input`, `Select` and `Textarea` straight on the canvas in the form column, with Cancel and Create at the end of the column. Validation runs only on submit. A required field carries the Required marker from the start; on submit an empty or filled but wrong one takes `invalid`, and a `Field.Error` (danger text with a leading alert icon) adds the message under the description, which keeps its guidance; there is no summary. Submit moves focus to the first field in error. A rejected request that no field owns raises an error toast with Retry and keeps the entries. A rejection a field owns, a key already in use, lands on that field and in a danger `Alert` above the fields, and never toasts. A successful save raises a success toast and clears the form. Its toasts go through `toast` into the app's one toast region (ToastPlugin, or one Toaster at the app root), never a Toaster in the page body. While the form loads, `Skeleton` rows stand in for the fields and Create is disabled. The block fetches nothing: Create emits `submit` with the values, and the page passes back `submitting`, `error`, `takenKey` or `saved`. Below md the actions stack at full width. Its page-level parts are `PageHeader`; the Section variants add `Subheader`, `SettingsRow`, `SaveBar`, `AppHeader`, `Breadcrumb`, `Card`, `Item`, `MultiSelect`, `RadioGroup`, `Switch`, `NumberInput` and `Alert`. The Section variants move the same rules to a long sectioned Create Service page (the creation header, section headings over flush `Card` groups of `Item` rows, a sticky `SaveBar`): another user deleted the linked origin, Save comes back with an error the Origin section owns, the page scrolls there, one danger `Alert` under the heading says what happened with the recovery action on it (Reload origins), and the Origin select turns invalid with its own reason and takes the focus; reloading swaps the select for a `Skeleton` and disables Save, and once reloaded the Alert closes and the select asks for another origin. Never a toast, never a summary. A page body for a create page: render it under the focused creation header (top-bar/top-bar-creation), not in ConsoleLayout.

variants.name: ValidationErrors
variants.summary: Create pressed with gaps. The empty Value and Environment and the malformed key take the invalid state, each shows its own Field.Error under the kept description, and focus moves to Key.

variants.name: Submitting
variants.summary: The request is in flight. Create shows its loading state, and the fields and Cancel are disabled so the entries cannot change mid-save.

variants.name: ServerError
variants.summary: The request failed and no field owns the failure. An error Toast says what failed and carries Retry, the lock is released, and every entry stays as typed.

variants.name: Conflict
variants.summary: The server rejected a value one field owns: the key is already in use. A danger Alert above the fields says so and that the entries are kept, Key takes the invalid state with its reason and the focus, and nothing toasts.

variants.name: Saved
variants.summary: The save went through. A success Toast names the new variable and where it is available, and the form is cleared for the next entry.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The form while its data loads, such as the environments it offers or the record an edit form opens with. Skeleton rows hold the layout, and Create stays disabled until the fields arrive.

variants.name: SectionRejected
variants.summary: A long Create Service form whose linked origin another user deleted, after Save: the page scrolls to the Origin section, the danger Alert opens under its heading with Reload origins, and focus lands on the Origin select, which reads This origin no longer exists.

variants.name: SectionReloading
variants.summary: Reload origins in flight: its button shows the loading state, the Origin select gives way to a Skeleton, and Save is disabled until the list is back.

variants.name: SectionReloaded
variants.summary: The list is reloaded without the deleted origin: the Alert closes, the select is cleared and stays invalid with Select an origin to continue.
